# Investment Memorandum

## 1. Executive Summary

- On May 15, 2024, Movado Group, Inc. and its lending syndicate executed Amendment No. 6 to their Amended and Restated Credit Agreement originally dated October 12, 2018.
- Movado Group, Inc., a New York corporation, serves as the parent company with multiple subsidiary borrowers including Movado Group Delaware Holdings Corporation, Movado LLC, Movado Retail Group, Inc., and MGI Luxury Group GmbH (Swiss entity). The credit facility also includes Movado Group Nederland B.V. as guarantor.
- Bank of America, N.A. serves as Administrative Agent, L/C Issuer, and Swingline Lender, with PNC Bank, National Association participating as a lender in the syndicate.
- The purpose of this amendment is to terminate the ability to borrow in Canadian Dollars under the credit facility. All references to "Canadian Dollar(s)", "CDOR", "CDOR Rate", and related provisions are being disregarded going forward.
- Movado Group is a luxury watch and accessories company with international operations, as evidenced by its Swiss and Netherlands subsidiaries.

## 2. Investment Highlights & Risks

### Key Strengths / Credit Positives:
- Established banking relationships with high-quality financial institutions (Bank of America and PNC Bank), indicating continued lender confidence
- The amendment represents operational simplification rather than financial distress, suggesting proactive portfolio management
- All loan documents and covenants remain in full force and effect, with no defaults or events of default occurring
- International diversification through subsidiaries in Switzerland and Netherlands provides geographic revenue diversification

### Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:
- Limited financial information available to assess overall credit quality and performance metrics
- Currency simplification may indicate reduced international business activity in Canadian markets, potentially signaling strategic shifts
